title: Cloning a single Panel then deleting the clone doesn't make the Editing Mode settings reappear with the single Panel
line: Deleting a panel from its Panel Settings now brings edit mode back to its normal full-size layout instead of leaving it squeezed to one side.
explanation: Pressing Delete Panel in a panel's Panel Settings deletes that panel's view while the dialog is still open. ShellCorona disconnects the view from itself before deleting it, so panelBeingConfiguredChanged is never emitted and the desktop's edit-mode view keeps leaving room for the closed dialog, staying shrunk to the left even after leaving and re-entering edit mode. The change remembers whether the deleted view was being configured and emits panelBeingConfiguredChanged after deleting it.

commits.message:
shell: don't keep edit mode squeezed after deleting a panel

Deleting a panel from its open Panel Settings left the edit mode desktop
shrunk to one side, because its view is disconnected before deletion and
nothing says the dialog closed. Emit panelBeingConfiguredChanged then.

BUG: 524360

media.caption: Master: a single bottom panel cloned to the top, the clone's Panel Settings open in edit mode
Master, after Delete Panel on the clone: no dialog left, but the edit-mode desktop stays shrunk to the left as if one were open
With the fix: same state, the clone's Panel Settings open
With the fix, after Delete Panel: edit mode returns to its normal centred full-size layout

review.text: This fixes the main symptom at its cause: the deleted view is disconnected before deletion, so panelBeingConfiguredChanged never fires. Emitting it afterwards when that view was being configured is minimal, and the after shot shows the normal edit-mode layout. However, the patch no longer applies on origin/master, because new availableScreenRectChanged lines sit in the same block. The queue also listed the 'Manage Desktops and Panels' visibility as part of the bug, and that is still not recomputed here.
changes: Rebase onto current origin/master (trivial conflict next to the new availableScreenRectChanged emit in the destroyedChanged handler).
Either recompute the manage-containments action visibility in the same place, or state in the MR that only the squeezed preview is fixed.
